name: secret-guard
description: Holds back a prompt that looks like it carries a secret (API keys, tokens, access-key pairs, private keys, passwords) before it reaches the transcript, puts it back in the box, and offers to save the secret as an env var in ~/.zshrc and send $NAME instead. No model calls.

enabled.title: Check prompts for secrets
enabled.description: Scan each prompt you send for keys, tokens and passwords and hold it back when one is found. Off: prompts are never checked (/secrets test still works).

extraPatterns.title: Also a secret (regex)
extraPatterns.description: A regular expression for more secrets to catch, e.g. kit_[a-z0-9]{32}. With a capture group, group 1 is the secret.

zshrcPath.title: Shell file to save secrets to
zshrcPath.description: Where Save as env var appends export NAME='value' lines. ~ is your home folder; a relative path is under it.
